parts:
Hi there, 

First, many thanks for this awesome LPA package. I'm currently running into issues with the bootstrap_lrt function. It will not work despite many attempts-- just keeps crashing my system. I know this is still under development but I see that several others on the thread have used it successfully. Do you have any work-arounds or could you recommend other options for a Lo-Mendell-Rubin Adjusted LRT, or comparable test. 

Thanks,
